name: Levomefolic Acid

similar.name: Methotrexate
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for breathing problems, liver harm and blood problems

fda.text: Keep out of the reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, seek professional emergency assistance or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. This product should be chewed and is not recommended for children under age 4.

summary: Levomefolic Acid must be kept away from children, should be chewed, is not recommended for children under 4 years old, and requires emergency medical or poison control help if an accidental overdose happens [4]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high risk score for liver harm and a low risk score for heart harm [M]. A related medicine called Methotrexate has a strict warning for breathing troubles, liver harm, and blood issues [3].
